realReviews.author: Chris O'Brien
realReviews.text:
Kurt was quick to respond to our leaking tile roof. The job was more complex than originally thought & involved replacing a very rusted valley gutter & numerous damaged tiles on the 50 year old terra cotta tiled roof. He did an excellent job & knew exactly what he was doing. I would highly recommend Kurt for any tile roof repair.
Chris

realReviews.author: Steve Yasuba
realReviews.text:
My roof was leaking and my skylight was leaking. Kurt and his crew did a free quote and had my roof and skylight fixed within a few days. Super happy with the work.
Would highly recommend Pro Tip roofing
Cheers boys

realReviews.author: Monique Murnane
realReviews.text: Kurt was prompt, friendly and reasonably priced. He fixed the hole causing a leak into the house, replaced loose tiles and cleaned the gutters. He got the job done in a timely manner and was easy to talk to and came when he said he would. Thanks Kurt!

finalCta.headline: Got a leak or a tired roof?
finalCta.body: Send a few photos or pick a time for an inspection. You'll get a free, no-obligation quote.

faq.a: Yes. Quotes are free and there's no obligation.

faq.q: Can you fix a leak someone else couldn't?
faq.a: Often, yes. We look for the real cause, whether it's tiles, pointing, flashing or a valley gutter.

faq.q: Do you work on old terracotta roofs?
faq.a: Yes. Re-pointing, tile replacement and valley gutters on older tiled roofs.
Carnegie and the surrounding Melbourne area. Ask if you're unsure.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to Kurt, you get a text and email confirmation, and he follows up to arrange your quote.
